facts.summary: Janssen collaboration terminated, workforce cut, NK programs discontinued · Phase 1 · FT596 CAR NK in B-cell lymphoma · not yet approved

evidence.summary: it has declined a proposal from Janssen Biotech, Inc. (“Janssen”) for continuation of the collaboration and option agreement between the parties on revised terms and conditions and, as a result, the agreement has been terminated
evidence.program_discontinued: is discontinuing clinical development of its FT516 and FT538 NK cell programs in acute myeloid leukemia, its FT516 and FT596 NK cell programs in B-cell lymphoma
